findings.body: The function's documentation says it shortens to "at most `limit` characters", but when the first `limit` characters contain no space, the returned string is `limit + 1` characters long (the ellipsis is added). This breaks any caller that relies on the hard limit, such as a check-run title capped by GitHub. The tests even allow `limit + 1`, but the public contract is explicit. Reserve one character for the ellipsis, or return an empty string for `limit == 0`.
findings.title: Respect the character limit when no space exists

findings.body: The repository rule requires every `src/` module to have a corresponding documentation file at `docs/modules/<module>/README.md`. This new module `src/findings/summarise.rs` does not include such a file in the diff, and the module's public functions are not covered by any existing documentation file.
